title: White textarea/IME flash for split second when clicking done(√) button in keyboard
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in any versions of the Godot Android Editor.

### System information

Android 11(Realme C12) - Godot(all Android editor versions)

### Issue description

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e0caae55-0efb-4c23-8280-412754275091

While in any textbox, if I click the confirm button(the checkmark at bottom right) in the keyboard, there's a white flash for split second. This happens in the textboxes of exported games as well. **IT DOES NOT HAPPEN** if I close the keyboard by pressing on a spot of screen **instead of clicking the confirm button.**

(What I believe) This white part is what is usually shown for textboxes of many apps, and it's where typed texts appear in those places. 

NOTE as i mentioned: This happens in both Godot Android Editor and also apps exported from Godot.

Expected: the keyboard should close normally like it does when clicking at an area of the screen, instead of briefly flashing the white textarea/IME.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Tap and open any textbox/textarea in the Godot Android Editor app or any of its exported apps.
2. Click the checkmark at bottom right of the keyboard(the "done" button that confirms and closes the keyboard), typing anything is optional as it happens if left blank as well.
3. White flash appears for split second!

N/A
